primary_penal_code: Theft Act 1968 & Offences Against Person Act 1861

statutes.title: Basic Definition of Theft
statutes.description: A person is guilty of theft if he dishonestly appropriates property belonging to another with the intention of permanently depriving the other of it.
statutes.penalty: Maximum penalty on indictment: 7 years imprisonment.

statutes.title: Burglary of Domestic or Commercial Building
statutes.description: A person is guilty of burglary if he enters any building or part of a building as a trespasser with intent to commit theft or grievous bodily harm.
statutes.penalty: Maximum penalty for domestic burglary: 14 years imprisonment.

statutes.act_name: Matrimonial Causes Act 1973 (as amended by Divorce, Dissolution & Separation Act 2020)
statutes.title: Divorce on No-Fault Irretrievable Breakdown
statutes.description: Application for divorce stating irretrievable breakdown of marriage without requirement to prove marital fault.

statutes.title: Unfair Prejudice Petition by Shareholder
statutes.description: A member of a company may apply to court by petition for an order on the ground that the company's affairs are being conducted in a manner unfairly prejudicial to the interests of members.

statutes.act_name: Protection from Harassment Act 1997 / Voyeurism Offences Act 2019
statutes.title: Stalking and Taking Photos Without Consent
statutes.description: Taking photographs or monitoring individuals in public or private spaces causing distress, alarm, or violation of personal dignity without consent.
statutes.penalty: Imprisonment of up to 2 years or fine, or both.

statutes.title: Fraud by False Representation
statutes.description: A person is in breach of this section if he dishonestly makes a false representation and intends by making the representation to make a gain for himself or another, or cause loss to another.
statutes.penalty: Imprisonment of up to 10 years or fine, or both.

statutes.title: Careless and Inconsiderate Driving
statutes.description: If a person drives a mechanically propelled vehicle on a road or other public place without due care and attention, or without reasonable consideration for other persons.
statutes.penalty: Fine up to GBP 5,000, penalty points, and disqualification from driving.

statutes.title: Right Not to be Unfairly Dismissed
statutes.description: An employee has the right not to be unfairly dismissed by his employer. Gives right to claim before Employment Tribunal.

statutes.title: Goods to be of Satisfactory Quality
statutes.description: Every contract to supply goods is to be treated as including a term that the quality of the goods is satisfactory. Entitles consumer to repair, replacement, or full refund.
